description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring, setting up, and tearing down a network connection via a modem using the NCM protocol. It includes functions for initialization, modem configuration, connection management, and cleanup, with external dependencies on various scripts and utilities.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the NCM protocol, setting default values and adding configuration parameters.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the network interface by configuring the modem, establishing connection, and creating DHCP and DHCPv6 configurations.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the network interface by disconnecting the modem and cleaning up resources.
